name: Backend Application Architecture
description: Backend Application Architecture standard. Defines enforceable rules, implementation boundaries, failure handling and review evidence expected when STD-BE-ARCH applies.

rules.title: Separate delivery, application/domain and infrastructure responsibilities
rules.detail: HTTP/queue/framework concerns do not contain core business rules; domain/application logic is testable without hosting infrastructure.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Separate delivery, application/domain and infrastructure responsibilities.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Separate delivery, application/domain and infrastructure responsibilities.

rules.title: Define one application use-case boundary for each business operation
rules.detail: Controllers/handlers translate input and delegate to explicit use cases/services that own orchestration, validation and transaction intent.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Define one application use-case boundary for each business operation.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Define one application use-case boundary for each business operation.

rules.title: Keep dependency direction inward
rules.detail: Domain/application layers depend on abstractions; infrastructure implements those abstractions and is composed at the application boundary.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Keep dependency direction inward.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Keep dependency direction inward.

rules.title: Do not expose persistence entities as public API contracts
rules.detail: Use explicit request/response/domain models where persistence shape and public contract can evolve independently.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Do not expose persistence entities as public API contracts.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Do not expose persistence entities as public API contracts.

rules.title: Centralize cross-cutting behavior in approved middleware/pipeline mechanisms
rules.detail: Authentication, authorization, correlation, logging and exception mapping should not be duplicated ad hoc in every endpoint.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Centralize cross-cutting behavior in approved middleware/pipeline mechanisms.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Centralize cross-cutting behavior in approved middleware/pipeline mechanisms.

rules.title: Design services for stateless horizontal scaling unless stateful ownership is explicit
rules.detail: Do not rely on process memory for durable session/business state without a documented single-owner architecture.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Design services for stateless horizontal scaling unless stateful ownership is explicit.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Design services for stateless horizontal scaling unless stateful ownership is explicit.

integration_guide.title: Resolve applicability and dependencies
integration_guide.description: Confirm where STD-BE-ARCH applies and resolve its extends/implements/uses/aligns_with dependencies in the project standard profile.

integration_guide.title: Record project decisions
integration_guide.description: Apply the rules of Backend Application Architecture to requirements/design/ADRs and record any project-specific thresholds, providers or justified exceptions.

integration_guide.title: Implement with evidence
integration_guide.description: Implement the applicable MUST/SHOULD rules and link code, configuration, tests or review evidence to the change.

integration_guide.title: Verify before completion
integration_guide.description: Run automated checks where possible and manual review for judgement-based rules; close or approve documented deviations.

common_issues.issue: Backend Application Architecture is applied inconsistently across features
common_issues.cause: The project references the standard but does not resolve concrete ownership, thresholds or verification evidence.
common_issues.solution: Resolve dependencies, record project-specific decisions and include applicable rules in implementation/review checks.

common_issues.issue: Implementation satisfies the happy path but misses Backend Application Architecture failure cases
common_issues.cause: Boundary, retry, security or recovery scenarios were not included in acceptance/test planning.
common_issues.solution: Use the standard rules to add explicit failure/recovery scenarios and verify them before release.
